g.title: PRING_Final_ImplementationReady_Thesis
g.text: PRING — final implementation-ready schema for PubChem-driven compound–protein interaction KG

g.title: cluster_textmine
g.text: F) Text-mined links (kept separate from curated evidence)

g.title: cluster_modeling
g.text: H) Derived interaction modeling layer (PRING materialization)

g.title: Conv1
g.text: Solid edges = persisted PubChem-derived core graph

g.title: Conv2
g.text: Dashed edges = optional enrichment, text-mined, or derived links

g.title: Conv3
g.text: Red bold self-edge on Compound = explicit compound-to-compound relations
used instead of a vague generic neighbors bucket for production modeling

g.title: Conv4
g.text: Structure / Properties / Synonyms / Neighbors are preserved from the original PRING concept schema,
but PRING may flatten Structure/Properties/Synonyms into Compound properties at load time

g.title: BindingDB
g.text: props: ligand_id?, kd?, ki?, ic50?, affinity_type?, affinity_value?, smiles?, inchikey?, parse_status?, source_ref?

g.title: MolGraph
g.text: formula descriptors, method, fp_type?, dim?, version

g.title: ProtEmbed
g.text: props: method, model_family, model_name, dim, pooling, storage_uri, version, emb_*?

g.title: Reference
g.text: props: title?, doi?, pmid?, patent_id?, year?

g.title: Endpoint
g.text: normalized molar interval, pX, normalization status/eligibility,

g.title: Interaction
g.text: props: label, confidence, evidence_count, assay/reference counts,
